summary: NFC epoxy key tags combine a clear or printed resin dome with an embedded NFC chip, creating a premium, durable tag in virtually any custom shape. Used for access control, loyalty programs, promotional giveaways and brand merchandise — the epoxy dome provides scratch resistance, UV protection and a distinctive high-gloss finish.
